name: ifftshift
expr: y_e = ifftshift(v8); y_o = ifftshift(v7); y_M = ifftshift(M); y_M1 = ifftshift(M, 1); y_M2 = ifftshift(M, 2); rt = fftshift(ifftshift(v7));
comment: Sig: Y = ifftshift(X[, dim]). Inverse of fftshift; cyclic shift along every non-singleton dim by floor(extent/2). Joint fix with fftshift on 2026-05-08 — they were swapped for odd-extent dims. tol=0.
